A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VGA research work in 14 readable pages, including Appendices A-G. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish complete coverage of the methods, equations, figures and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original VGA benchmark experiments, grounding analyses, ablations and latency measurements, including supplementary AMBER and MME results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, with numerical revisions to two TARAC baseline rows.

M1.justification: VSC/VSS grounding, VGA attention updates, head balancing and programmed visual grounding remain identical in Sections 3-4. Appendix G's first-token approximation is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same POPE datasets, CHAIR, AMBER and MME coverage, including the attribute and relation tasks in Appendix F.

E2.justification: Vanilla, PAI, PAI with contrastive decoding, VAF and TARAC retain identical participation in corresponding comparisons. Only some TARAC scores change.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix A retain the same models, splits, sample sizes, metrics, decoding procedures and baseline settings. No protocol change or experimental rerun is documented.

E4.justification: The grounding and failure analyses, programmed-guidance ablations, head-balancing and early-termination tests, and hyperparameter studies are unchanged, including Tables 4, 6 and 7.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting and sampling disclosures are identical, including the correlation estimate of 0.414 ± 0.019 in Section 5.4.1. No uncertainty estimates or run-count information are added or revised.

E6.justification: For TARAC with LLaVA-13B, Table 2 changes (Cs, Ci, F1) from (43.0, 11.2, 75.1) to (42.6, 11.6, 76.9). Appendix Table 5 changes (CHAIR, Cover, Hal, Cog, AMBER) from (5.8, 49.3, 28.5, 2.9, 35.25) to (5.6, 49.5, 25.1, 2.4, 35.35). TARAC consequently becomes second-best on Table 5's Hal metric. All VGA results and other reported outcomes remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, attention-update derivations, grounding assumptions and appendix formulas are identical. No theoretical argument or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about accurate grounding, hallucination mitigation, training-free operation, single-pass inference and FlashAttention compatibility.

C2.justification: The interpretations, captioning tradeoffs and failure explanations remain unchanged, including the discussion of degraded visual features and unreliable grounding in Section 5.4.2.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, layer choices, Stanza usage, decoding limits, GPU information and code-access link are unchanged. No additional reproducibility information accompanies the numerical revisions.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning and all 41 references remain identical.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2 dated 24 March 2026 to v3 dated 29 April 2026. All substantive prose, headings and document organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, table structures, captions, graphical emphasis and page layout are unchanged. The numerical edits in Tables 2 and 5 belong to E6; no corresponding formatting revision occurs.

improvement.justification: The numerical revisions leave VGA's results and main conclusions unchanged, but introduce a small reporting inconsistency: Table 5 still underlines PAI's Hal score of 27.3 as second-best, although TARAC's revised 25.1 now holds that rank. The PDFs do not establish that the unexplained numerical updates improve accuracy, while this loss of consistency is directly observable.
